Imbria is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Justlife
providers.description: Justlife is the Middle East's leading home-services super app, connecting customers with vetted professionals for on-demand cleaning, beauty and wellness, healthcare-at-home, laundry, and home maintenance. Founded in 2015 by Cagatay Ozcan and Kerem Kuyucu, the company operates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain through its consumer mobile apps and website. Justlife publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, policy, security, and AI-agent (llms.txt) surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kouper Health
providers.description: Kouper Health (Kouper) is a healthcare technology company building an AI-agent orchestration layer for care navigation, deployed on top of a provider organization's existing EHR. The platform spans the full patient journey through three named agents: PRIMUS for patient access and inbound coordination (appointment scheduling, intake, insurance verification, missed-call recovery), ARCHIE for inpatient and post-acute navigation (discharge planning, home health attachment, LUPA risk), and CURA for ongoing care coordination and management (proactive outreach, reminders, check-ins, escalation). Kouper sells to health systems, independent and specialty provider groups, clinically integrated networks, risk-bearing entities, and payers, with multilingual patient engagement, human escalation, and HIPAA-compliant workflows. The company emerged from stealth in May 2025 with a $10M seed round led by General Catalyst with 25Madison and CVS Health Ventures, and operates out of New York, San Francisco, and Nashville. As of this profile Kouper publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts — the product is delivered as a managed EHR-integrated service rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Lina
providers.description: Lina is a medical coworking company providing space, community, and support for independent healthcare practitioners in private practice. Founded by Vicrum Puri and Rachel Puri, Lina offers turnkey private office suites alongside on-demand medical, therapy, and bodywork spaces that are HIPAA and OSHA compliant and bookable by the hour or by the day. Locations operate in NoMad and Grand Central in New York City and Aventura, Florida, with expansion announced for Washington DC, West Palm Beach, the Upper West Side, and Brooklyn. Lina is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. It operates a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Neuros Medical
providers.description: Neuros Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Arden Hills, Minnesota, and the maker of the Altius Direct Electrical Nerve Stimulation System — an implantable, patient-controlled high-frequency nerve block indicated as an aid in the management of chronic intractable phantom and residual lower limb post-amputation pain in adult amputees. The system pairs a nerve cuff electrode placed around a peripheral nerve with an implantable pulse generator and a handheld patient controller, and received FDA approval in 2024 after FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and the QUEST pivotal trial. The company sells an implantable therapy to health systems, pain physicians and amputees; it operates a marketing and patient-education website and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: New Lantern
providers.description: New Lantern is a cloud-native, AI-native radiology platform that unifies the worklist, PACS/DICOM viewer, and AI-powered reporting into a single browser-based workspace, replacing the fragmented multi-system software stack most radiology practices run today. Its cloud-native DICOM viewer offers 3D/MPR/MIP reconstruction, mammography and PET/CT modes, and AI hanging protocols; its Curie AI reporting assistant drafts reports that a licensed radiologist reviews, edits, and signs; and NL-Vox provides radiology-tuned speech recognition, alongside intelligent worklist and case distribution, analytics, and native Epic/Oracle Health EHR integration. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, New Lantern is backed by a $19M Series A led by Benchmark and is FDA registered as a Class I medical image communications device (21 CFR 892.2020). New Lantern does not currently expose a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web/security posture.

providers.name: Nuvaira
providers.description: Nuvaira, Inc. is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, founded in 2008 to treat overactive airway nerves in people living with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Its dNerva Lung Denervation System is a catheter-based, radiofrequency device used in a bronchoscopic procedure called Targeted Lung Denervation (TLD), which the FDA has designated a Breakthrough Device. The company holds more than 70 issued and pending patents worldwide, has treated over 500 patients across its AIRFLOW clinical program, and is currently running the pivotal AIRFLOW-3 trial. Nuvaira sells a regulated physical therapeutic device to hospitals and interventional pulmonologists; it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Nym
providers.description: Nym is a healthcare technology company providing autonomous medical coding for health systems, hospitals, and physician groups. Its proprietary Clinical Language Understanding (CLU) engine reads clinical documentation and assigns accurate medical codes (ICD-10, CPT, and E/M) without human intervention, combining machine reading with transparent, rules-based coding logic rather than generic natural language processing. Nym automates revenue cycle management to reduce coding costs, accelerate billing, and improve charge capture across 400+ US healthcare facilities, and is used by health systems including OSF, Ochsner Health, Inova, and Henry Ford. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Nym does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Onco.com
providers.description: Onco.com is a comprehensive cancer care platform operated by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd that connects cancer patients across India with oncologists and treatment services. The platform offers priority expert oncology consultations, pan-India cancer medicine delivery at discounted rates, diagnostic testing and imaging, curated treatment packages with negotiated hospital rates, and the CanWin peer support group for survivors and caregivers. Onco.com reports a network of 400+ oncologists and 23+ treatment centers, having served more than 100,000 patients. It also publishes extensive patient-education content covering many cancer types (breast, lung, blood, prostate, colon, and others) through its About Cancer library and blog. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company; the platform is consumer/patient facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Opna Bio
providers.description: Opna Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on oncology, developing novel small-molecule and targeted-degrader therapeutics against key regulators of cancer, including the Hallmarks of Cancer. Its pipeline features OPN-6602 (an EP300/CBP inhibitor in Phase 1 for multiple myeloma, granted FDA Fast Track designation), zavabresib (OPN-2853, a BET inhibitor with Orphan Drug designation for myelofibrosis), multi-functional protein degraders, and additional programs targeting hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. The company operates from South San Francisco and San Diego, California, and Lausanne, Switzerland.

providers.name: Pedestal Health (formerly Target RWE)
providers.description: Pedestal Health, formerly Target RWE (and NoviSci), is a Durham, North Carolina real-world evidence and health-data company serving life sciences organizations and health systems. It generates regulatory-grade real-world evidence from large-scale observational data and longitudinal patient cohorts across hepatology, dermatology, and gastroenterology (including the TARGET-NASH, TARGET-Derm, and TARGET-Gastro registries), supporting clinical development, regulatory strategy, and care delivery. The company operates as a data, research, and services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched from the company's public website (targetrwe.com now redirects to pedestalhealth.com).

providers.name: Peel Therapeutics
providers.description: Peel Therapeutics is an evolutionary-medicine biotechnology company headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, with research teams in the United States and Israel. Co-founded in 2015 by pediatric oncologist Dr. Joshua Schiffman, the company translates molecules that evolution has already validated in nature into therapeutics for patients with cancer and inflammatory disease. Its founding program is built on elephant p53 (EP53) — elephants carry roughly forty copies of the p53 tumor-suppressor gene against the human two — delivered as liposomal protein nanoparticles, alongside PEEL-224, a TOP1 inhibitor in clinical development. Discovery runs on the company's proprietary, internal Darwin.AI platform and the Darwin Biobank, a comparative-oncology sample collection. Peel is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Pluro
providers.description: Pluro is India's fertility and IVF platform, built as a co-creation model with doctors for patients. It delivers personalised, evidence-based reproductive care through a growing network of 15+ clinics across India, combining advanced clinical science, AI-assisted embryology, standardised treatment protocols, and transparent pricing. Founded by Dr. Bhaskar Shah, Dr. Jaydeep Tank, and Dr. Parikshit Tank, Pluro raised a Rs 125 crore Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners in 2025. It offers IVF/ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, and a range of diagnostic and surgical fertility treatments. Pluro publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: QurAlis
providers.description: QurAlis Corporation is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded on December 12, 2016 in Cambridge, Massachusetts by Drs. Kasper Roet, Kevin Eggan and Clifford Woolf together with Q-State Biosciences, and staffed by neurodegenerative biologists out of Harvard Medical School and Harvard University. The company develops precision medicines for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and other neurodegenerative and neurological diseases, built on the discovery — published in Nature Neuroscience by co-founder Kevin Eggan's lab — that loss of normal TDP-43 function drives a decrease in STATHMIN-2 (STMN2) expression and impairs neuronal repair. Its lead candidates are QRL-201, a first-in-class molecule intended to restore STMN2 expression in ALS (ANQUR trial), and QRL-101, a potentially best-in-class selective Kv7.2/7.3 ion channel opener for hyperexcitability-induced disease progression in ALS as well as epilepsy and pain; a third program targets UNC13A cryptic-exon mis-splicing. Therapies are built on the proprietary FlexASO® anti-sense oligonucleotide splice-modulator platform. QurAlis publishes a corporate site covering its story, pipeline, platform, people, patient resources, presentations and press releases, but runs no developer program: no API documentation, no SDKs, no developer portal, no GitHub organisation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: ROMTech
providers.description: ROMTech (ROM Technologies, Inc.) is a privately held medical technology company headquartered in Brookfield, Connecticut that builds connected orthopedic rehabilitation technology. Its flagship product, the PortableConnect Adaptive Telemed Technology, is a prescription, clinician-delivered home rehabilitation device for patients recovering from total knee replacement, total hip replacement, joint manipulation and ACL repair. Adaptive pedal technology adjusts automatically to a patient's current range of motion across four therapy modes (passive, active-assisted, active and resistance); the AccuAngle Bluetooth wearable measures knee flexion and extension during each session; and the PortableConnect App runs a prescribed protocol of three to five daily sessions over a typical four-to-eight-week plan. Session data — range of motion, adherence and key health metrics — streams to a Clinician Portal where the prescribing surgeon reviews real-time reports and adjusts the protocol remotely, with in-app telemedicine for face-to-face follow-ups. The technology began as the ROM3 Rehab device. ROMTech was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list for 2025 and to the LexisNexis Top 100 Global Innovators for 2026, and sells to clinicians, health systems and the Department of Veterans Affairs. ROMTech runs no public developer program: it publishes no OpenAPI, SDK, webhook catalog or developer documentation, and the Clinician Portal at portal.romtech.com is a closed single-page application backed by a private, undocumented API at middleware.romtech.com/api.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Swing Therapeutics
providers.description: Swing Therapeutics is a San Francisco digital therapeutics company founded in 2019 that develops evidence-based, smartphone-delivered treatments for chronic illness. Its lead product, Stanza, is a 12-week prescription digital therapeutic delivering Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) for the management of fibromyalgia symptoms in adults, and in 2023 it became the first digital therapeutic to receive FDA De Novo marketing authorization for that indication. Stanza is prescribed by clinicians and dispensed to patients as a native iOS/Android application; the company also operates Swing Care, a virtual fibromyalgia clinic offering physician visits, medication management and coaching. Swing Therapeutics and Swing Care were acquired by XRHealth in July 2026. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification — its software is delivered exclusively as a regulated end-user therapy, and it is an API consumer (its clinical operations run on the Healthie EHR API) rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Synapsor
providers.description: Synapsor (legal entity Ottai Technology (Wuxi) Co. Ltd.) is a Chinese medical-device company based in Wuxi, Jiangsu that develops AI-powered, medical-grade smart wearable devices. Its flagship product is the Ottai continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system - a waterproof, calibration-free wearable sensor paired with a mobile app and AI assistant for 24/7 glucose tracking and diabetes management, sold in China and internationally via ottai.com. Investors include Qiming Venture Partners, Huatai Zijin Investment, Wuxi Industry Development Group, YuanBio Venture Capital, and Shunwei Capital. Synapsor publishes no public developer API, portal, or machine-readable API specifications as of July 2026.

providers.name: Tembo Health
providers.description: Tembo Health is a telemedicine practice (founded 2018) that partners with skilled nursing facilities and senior living communities to deliver 24/7 virtual specialty and urgent care to elderly residents. Its board-certified clinicians provide treat-in-place emergency medicine, psychiatry, cardiology, and dementia care, reducing avoidable ER transfers by roughly 75 percent, and the company works with senior-care operators and EHR platforms such as PointClickCare. Tembo Health is a healthcare services provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Terremoto Biosciences
providers.description: Terremoto Biosciences is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, building a covalent drug discovery and development engine around lysine-based covalency. Founded in 2022 by veterans of Principia Biopharma and backed by OrbiMed and Third Rock Ventures across Series A ($75M), Series B ($175M) and Series C ($108M) financings, the company designs highly selective small-molecule medicines aimed both at improving on known drug targets and at reaching targets previously considered undruggable. Its lead program, TER-2013, is an AKT1-selective inhibitor granted FDA Fast Track designation for breast cancer, with additional work in oncology and hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia. Terremoto is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable API contract, and its public web surface is a corporate marketing site covering science, pipeline, news and careers.

providers.name: TheraNest
providers.description: TheraNest (now marketed as Ensora Mental Health) is a behavioral and mental health practice management and EHR platform for therapists, counselors, psychologists, and social workers. It covers client intake, scheduling, telehealth, clinical documentation and notes, treatment plans, client portals, insurance billing and claims, and reporting. TheraNest is the flagship mental health product of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands). As of this review, Ensora does not publish a documented, self-serve public developer API for TheraNest - integration is via partnerships, HIPAA-gated interoperability, and contact-sales arrangements rather than an open developer portal. The API entries below are logical resource groupings modeled from the product surface; their endpoints are NOT documented public endpoints (endpointsModeled true).

providers.name: Whill
providers.description: WHILL, Inc. designs and manufactures enhanced personal mobility solutions — electric power chairs and mobility scooters, including the Model C2, Model F, the Modo Breeze ultralight foldable wheelchair, and the Model R three- and four-wheel scooters — and operates an autonomous personal mobility service that has completed over 700,000 rides worldwide across airports and other venues. WHILL was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this writing it is a consumer hardware and mobility-service company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record and will be enriched if WHILL launches a developer program.

providers.name: Cornerstone Robotics
providers.description: Cornerstone Robotics (CSR) is a Hong Kong-headquartered surgical robotics manufacturer founded in 2019 at Hong Kong Science Park, building the Sentire Endoscopic Surgical System (C1000) — a multi-specialty, minimally invasive robot-assisted surgery platform developed entirely in-house and indicated for general surgery, gynecology, thoracic and urology. The Sentire system has received regulatory clearance in China (NMPA), the European Union and Singapore, and has completed multicenter clinical trials in China and the United Kingdom. The company operates three global R&D hubs, six business centers and a 30,000 square meter manufacturing facility, and sells a regulated physical medical device rather than software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Elephant Healthcare
providers.description: Elephant Healthcare is a global health-technology company, headquartered in the UK, that partners with governments to digitise and strengthen public health systems across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Its flagship product, ElephantOS, is a mobile- and offline-first electronic health record (EHR) that streamlines clinical workflows for primary and secondary care facilities, serving over 19 million contracted patients across Nigeria, Kenya and Pakistan. The company also builds Elephant Nudge, a clinical co-pilot that guides and rewards quality of care, and Elephant Platform, an emerging AI-driven marketplace that connects clinicians to third-party healthcare software, medical devices and supply-chain partners. Elephant is backed by General Catalyst and Seedcamp. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Kymera Therapeutics
providers.description: Kymera Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at 500 North Beacon Street in Watertown, Massachusetts, pioneering targeted protein degradation as a way to build oral small-molecule medicines against targets that conventional inhibitors cannot reach. Rather than blocking a protein's activity, Kymera's degraders recruit the body's own protein-disposal machinery so that a binding event alone is sufficient to eliminate the disease-driving protein, an approach the company describes as a disease-agnostic modality. Its wholly-owned pipeline is led by KT-621, a once-daily oral STAT6 degrader in Phase 2 for Type 2 inflammatory diseases including atopic dermatitis, asthma, COPD and chronic spontaneous urticaria, and KT-579, a first-in-class oral IRF5 degrader in Phase 1 for lupus, Sjogren's syndrome and rheumatoid arthritis. Partnered programs include the oral IRAK4 degrader KT-485/SAR447971 with Sanofi and the CDK2 molecular glue degrader KT-200 with Gilead Sciences. Kymera publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, investor, patient and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: R1 RCM
providers.description: R1 RCM is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The R1 RCM API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: tab32
providers.description: tab32 is a cloud-based dental practice management, imaging, and analytics platform for dental practices and dental service organizations (DSOs). tab32 offers a real, commercial API - powered by Google Apigee and HIPAA / SOC 2 Type II compliant - that exposes tab32's patient, provider, schedule, charts, notes, ledger, and payments data objects to DSOs and third-party developers. Access is partner-gated, not open self-service - developers reach the API through tab32's developer API portal after establishing a partnership or enterprise relationship, and full endpoint reference, authentication, and base URL details live behind that portal rather than on the public website. The API entries below are modeled from tab32's publicly documented data objects and API messaging; their endpoint paths are not published publicly and are therefore illustrative, not confirmed.

providers.name: Tooth Fairy
providers.description: Toothfairy is a UK dental telehealth platform billing itself as the world's first dentist on-demand, pairing registered dentists with a consumer mobile app to deliver teeth straightening with clear aligners, prescription teeth whitening, and same-day emergency video dental consultations 24/7, plus employer dental plans for businesses. The company is health-regulated in the UK, backed by Seedcamp, and ships its product as iOS and Android apps with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: AbbVie
providers.description: AbbVie is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and markets advanced therapies in immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and other specialty areas. AbbVie's portfolio includes treatments for autoimmune diseases, various cancers, neurological disorders, and aesthetics through the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio.

providers.name: AstraZeneca
providers.description: AstraZeneca is a British-Swedish multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company focused on oncology, cardiovascular, renal, metabolism, and respiratory therapies. AstraZeneca does not publish a general developer portal or commercial public APIs; technology integration is delivered through enterprise partner programs, clinical trial data portals such as clinicaltrials.gov and the Vivli platform, and EDI/x12 channels used by distributors and pharmacy benefit managers.

providers.name: BoaConsulta
providers.description: BoaConsulta is a Brazilian digital-health platform, founded in 2012 and part of the Pixeon healthtech group, that connects patients, health professionals, and institutions. It pairs a free B2C marketplace for booking in-person consultations, teleconsultations, exams, and vaccinations with a full B2B/SaaS practice-management system (150+ integrated modules covering smart scheduling, electronic health records, telemedicine, financial management, TISS insurance billing, inventory, and automated reminders). The platform reports more than 58,000 health professionals, 1.7 million registered patients, and over 2 million appointments, with LGPD-compliant end-to-end encryption and daily automated backups. It has no public developer API; this profile is enriched from BoaConsulta's own public surfaces (llms.txt, status page, help center, blog, and legal pages).

providers.name: Centivo
providers.description: Centivo is a primary-care-centered health plan administrator for self-funded employers, founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City. Sold through benefits brokers and consultants, it serves mid-market employers (roughly 50 or more employees) and covers about 77,000 members across 160 businesses. Members get $0 primary care to encourage early intervention, and employers typically save 15-30% versus traditional fully-insured plans through a primary-care-first model, the cost advantages of self-funding, and directly negotiated health-system partnerships. Centivo operates member, employer, provider, and referral portals plus iOS/Android member apps; it does not publish a public developer API. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and JPMorgan Chase's Morgan Health.

providers.name: Medeloop
providers.description: Medeloop is an AI platform for the clinical research lifecycle, describing itself as an operating system for clinical research that spans grant discovery and funding, real-world evidence generation from patient data, and delivering actionable intelligence at the point of care. Its products include Medeloop Analytics (AI agents that analyze EHR, claims, and registry data without requiring users to code), EvidenceKit (analytics paired with all-payer claims data), Medeloop Grants (AI-assisted grant discovery and proposal writing), and Medeloop Care (population health and care management). The platform is federated (compute moves to the data, which stays in the customer's infrastructure), CDM-agnostic (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, OMOP, i2b2, or custom schemas), and model-agnostic (routing tasks across OpenAI, Anthropic, or DeepSeek), with multi-cloud deployment across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premise. It serves pharmaceutical and life-sciences companies, health systems, and clinical researchers. As of this enrichment pass Medeloop publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; its documentation host (docs.medeloop.ai) is gated behind Okta authentication and its analytics application is a private client login.

providers.name: Mindful Health Solutions
providers.description: Mindful Health Solutions is a behavioral-health-care provider specializing in innovative, evidence-based psychiatric treatments for depression, anxiety, PTSD, OCD, and other treatment-resistant conditions. Founded in 2007 (originally as TMS Health Solutions) by Dr. Richard Bermudes, the company pioneered TMS-focused clinics in the United States and offers Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), SPRAVATO (esketamine) nasal spray, IV Ketamine infusion therapy, medication management, and psychiatric care across roughly 20 clinics in California, Texas, and Washington. Mindful Health Solutions maintains one of the world's largest TMS and esketamine patient-outcome repositories. It is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As a clinical healthcare provider it publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, an AI-crawler llms.txt it publishes, and its domain-security posture.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: AZmed
providers.description: AZmed is a Paris-based medical-imaging AI company whose Rayvolve AI Suite assists radiologists by automatically analyzing X-rays and other studies. Its applications include AZtrauma (fracture detection), AZchest (chest imaging), AZmeasure (anatomical measurements), AZboneage (bone-age assessment) and AZnod (CT nodule detection). The software integrates into existing radiology workflows rather than being exposed as a public developer API, and is deployed across 2,500+ healthcare centers in 55+ countries, analyzing over 15 million X-rays annually, backed by 10+ peer-reviewed publications. As of this profile AZmed does not publish a public REST API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Biosplice Therapeutics
providers.description: Biosplice Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, founded in 2008 by Osman Kibar and known until its 2020 rename as Samumed, LLC (samumed.com still redirects to biosplice.com). The company develops first-in-class small-molecule therapeutics that act on novel components of the Wnt signaling pathway and on the regulation of alternative pre-mRNA splicing. Its lead program is lorecivivint, an investigational intra-articular knee injection for osteoarthritis, positioned against a stated unmet need of "over 50 million US patients suffer from osteoarthritis, with no drugs available to arrest the disease"; the candidate has completed Phase 3 study and a New Drug Application has been submitted to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Programs outside lorecivivint — neurology, diabetes and oncology — are developed by the company's affiliate TenaRx, Inc. The company is led by Erich Horsley (Chief Executive Officer) with Osman Kibar as Founder and Executive Chairman, Yusuf Yazici as Chief Medical Officer, Phil Wilson as Chief Financial Officer and Scott W. Bulcao as Chief Legal Officer. Biosplice is a drug-discovery and clinical-development organization, not a software vendor: biosplice.com is a small ASP.NET corporate site covering mission, board, management, advisors, programs, publications, news and careers, and the company publishes no developer program of any kind — no API, no SDK, no developer portal, no GitHub organization and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Eden
providers.description: Eden is a Latin American healthcare technology company providing cloud-based medical imaging and radiology software for hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centers. Its platform includes Eden PACS (a cloud picture archiving and communication system and DICOM viewer), Eden Management (scheduling, referral, and operational workflow tools), Eden Intelligence (data-driven analytics for medical institutions), and Eden Creator (an AI assistant for drafting diagnostic impressions). Eden is backed by Sierra Ventures and serves medical institutions across Latin America. No public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Eleanor Health
providers.description: Eleanor Health is a value-based, whole-person addiction and mental health care provider delivering virtual and in-person treatment for substance use disorders — including opioid, alcohol, stimulant, and prescription drug use — through medication for addiction treatment (MAT), therapy, peer recovery support, and health coaching. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company partners with health plans and Medicaid programs across multiple U.S. states to deliver measurement-based, outcomes-driven behavioral healthcare. Eleanor Health is backed by General Catalyst. It does not publish a public developer API program; member scheduling and clinical records run on athenahealth, and its public GitHub organization holds internal engineering tooling rather than a first-party API.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.description: Foundation Medicine is a molecular information and precision cancer diagnostics company that develops comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) tests for solid tumors, blood cancers, and sarcomas, including its FoundationOne family of assays. Its testing analyzes patient tumor and liquid-biopsy samples to identify genomic alterations that can inform targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and clinical-trial matching, and it partners with biopharma on companion diagnostics and clinical-trial enrollment. A Roche company, it has delivered more than 1.5 million patient CGP reports and supports 950+ clinical trials. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead (gv, kleiner-perkins) and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer API or portal, so this record captures its public web, legal, and security-disclosure surface.

providers.name: Grail
providers.description: GRAIL, Inc. is a healthcare company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, focused on detecting cancer early, when it can be cured. Its flagship product, the Galleri multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test, uses a single blood draw and methylation-based genomic sequencing to screen for a signal shared across more than 50 types of cancer, many of which lack any recommended screening today. GRAIL runs large clinical programs including the PATHFINDER, PATHFINDER 2, and NHS-Galleri studies, and distributes Galleri through health plans, employers, and partners such as Quest Diagnostics and Junction. GRAIL is a portfolio company of investors including GV and SV Angel. It does not publish a first-party public developer API; programmatic access to Galleri ordering is offered through third-party diagnostic infrastructure partners.

providers.name: Harbor Health
providers.description: Harbor Health is a Central Texas healthcare company building a vertically integrated "pay-vider" model that combines primary care, specialty care, and health coaching clinics with its own commercial and individual health insurance plans, so the same organization both delivers and covers care. Founded in 2022 by Dr. Clay Johnston (founding dean of UT Dell Medical School), Tony Miller, and Eric Scott, the company operates clinics and Express Care walk-in locations across the Austin, Dallas, El Paso, and San Antonio metros, and is pursuing a value-based care model for the commercial market. It is backed by General Catalyst, 8VC, and Alta Partners. Harbor Health publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web properties (member portal, plans, blog, privacy and terms) for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Healthcare.com
providers.description: Healthcare.com (HealthCare, Inc.) is a privately held, non-government health insurance marketplace and distribution platform founded in 2014. Consumers use healthcare.com to find, compare and enroll in ACA/under-65 individual health plans, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, and specialty coverage; distributors, FMOs, MGAs and agents use its Autopilot machine-learning enrollment acquisition platform, which matches high-intent shoppers to distributor partners with predictive scoring and value-based lead pricing. Its Pivot Health subsidiary develops and markets proprietary short-term medical, fixed indemnity and supplemental gap products with A-rated carriers. Insurance is sold through Healthcare.com Insurance Services, LLC. As of this profiling pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition or SDKs.

providers.name: Junomedical
providers.description: Junomedical (now Qunomedical) is a Berlin-based digital health company founded in 2015 by Dr. Sophie Chung that connects patients with professionally-vetted doctors and clinics for high-quality medical treatments at home and abroad. The consumer platform (qunomedical.com) offers free assessments, price matching, 24/7 patient support, and personalized treatment matching across specialties including plastic surgery, hair transplants, dentistry, oncology, orthopedics, reproductive medicine, and weight-loss surgery, serving roughly 10,000 patients a month. The company also builds Qunosuite, a patient-relationship-management (PRM) SaaS for healthcare providers. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a consumer marketplace and a provider SaaS but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Kuraseru
providers.description: KURASERU, INC. (株式会社KURASERU) is a Kobe-based Japanese technology company building digital-transformation software for the elderly-care industry. Founded in October 2017 by Taiki Kawahara, a former care worker and hospital medical social worker, the company describes its business as DX promotion for care-related services and system development. Its stated mission is to use technology to lift the administrative burden off care work so that caregivers can spend more of their time with the people they care for, addressing Japan's super-aging society, chronic caregiver shortages, and high turnover. KURASERU is ISO/IEC 27001 certified (IS 716039) and is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface, so this is a company profile rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Luminai
providers.description: Luminai is an AI-powered automation platform for health system operations, marketed as "The AI Platform for Health System Operations." It automates complex, high-volume healthcare back-office workflows including referral intake and processing, provider inbox automation, patient registration, orders and referrals, pharmacy renewals, payor contract management, denial appeals, and underpayment recovery. The company reports over 12 million automations driven, an average 5.3x ROI, and a 48-day average time to value, with enterprise-grade security and flexible deployment options (on-premises, VPC, or fully managed). Luminai is SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. It is a venture-backed company in the General Catalyst portfolio. Luminai does not publish a public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Offendersearch
providers.description: A commercial REST API (and private-beta MCP server) for nationwide US sex-offender registry screening, searching 58 US registries through one API with scored matches and per-source provenance.

providers.name: Ophelia
providers.description: Ophelia is a telehealth company delivering online treatment for opioid use disorder (OUD) through medication-assisted treatment (MAT). Founded in 2020 and based in Philadelphia, Ophelia combines evidence-based buprenorphine/naloxone (Suboxone) prescriptions with virtual clinical care, delivering diagnosis, prescriptions sent to local pharmacies, ongoing clinician support, and insurance coordination entirely remotely. Patients can be seen within 1-3 days and most pay under $10/month. Ophelia is a consumer-facing healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Rad AI
providers.description: Rad AI is a San Francisco based healthcare technology company that builds generative and machine-learning software for radiology. Its products help radiologists work faster and reduce burnout: Rad AI Reporting is a generative AI reporting platform, Rad AI Impressions automatically generates customized report impressions (reported to save radiologists 60+ minutes per shift), and Rad AI Continuity manages follow-up of incidental findings. The company is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certified and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Rad AI markets its clinical products directly to health systems and imaging groups and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance program for the API Evangelist network.
